overview: This Senate resolution honors the life and service of Senator Lindsey Graham of South Carolina following his death. It recounts his background, more than three decades of military service as an Air Force lawyer, and his time in the South Carolina House, the U.S. House and the U.S. Senate, where he chaired the Judiciary Committee and later the Budget Committee. It expresses the Senate's sorrow, sends a copy to his family and the House of Representatives, and adjourns the Senate for the day in his memory. Nearly every senator cosponsored it, and the Senate agreed to it on July 13, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a fitting tribute to a colleague who served South Carolina and the country for decades.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
